question: Should OpenClaw retire these root bundled skills now and establish Sherpa ONNX TTS as an official ClawHub-only plugin in the next release?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes shipped skill availability, user upgrade behavior, official package trust, dependency metadata, and native artifact distribution; code correctness alone cannot choose those product and release contracts.

options.title: Land with migration proof
options.body: Require doctor migration or an equivalent in-product upgrade path, current-head dependency authorization, published replacement coverage, and verified Sherpa package and artifact proof before merging.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Move the independently useful Sherpa external-plugin work into a narrow PR while retaining the current bundled starter set until its deprecation plan is ready.

options.title: Park the broad trim
options.body: Keep the existing bundled surface for this release and revisit removals through a release-owned deprecation proposal.

recommendation.title: Land with migration proof
recommendation.body: Require doctor migration or an equivalent in-product upgrade path, current-head dependency authorization, published replacement coverage, and verified Sherpa package and artifact proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the two merged prerequisite splits and supplied the clearest recent maintainer context defining the decisions left in this branch.
